protocol: object_token_episodic_memory_v1: bounded supervised storage/readout diagnostic only; each forward receives only current 11x11x7 public vision, previous chosen action, and previous scalar reward. Object masks derive solely from raw public tile pixels and only distinguish object from air/agent; learned grid-index parameters are internal model weights, not coordinate inputs. Labels, identity IDs, coordinates, seeds, teachers, planners, and shaped rewards are excluded from input and never transfer to Luanti control.
